# Pre-GX 2005 decks

Eight decks available as individual YDK files and card lists in `manifest.json`.

- Goat Control
- Warrior Toolbox
- Tribute Control
- Zombie Recruiter
- Gravekeeper
- Gardna Burn
- Ben Kei OTK
- Empty Jar

Goat Control and Tribute Control each contain 15 Fusion cards, including three Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

The five Main-only decks have no supplied Side or Fusion cards.

The native Free Play library already contains these decks.
